name: FusionQuest
title: West Capital fusion questline
description: Runs the West Capital questline that ends in the Metamoran fusion dance: Doberman's capsule case, the Red Ribbon factory and Androids 13-15, Bulma's Sixteen, air and gas jobs, Tongari Tower and Hatchiyack, Somen, King Kai and the dance drills. Type `fus help`.
author: Bruno Mouta

aliases.name: fus
aliases.script:
if matches[2] == "update" then return CKMudUpdate("FusionQuest") end
local function arg(s) if s and s ~= "" then return s end end
fus.command(arg(matches[2]), arg(matches[3]))
